measurement_note: Size n is s.length. Legal tiers 2048, 8192, and 32768 span 16x and concatenate strings in breadth-first order over a two-letter alphabet, so every emitted segment's proper prefixes have already appeared and the greedy procedure emits a growing prefix-closed corpus. Trie traversal touches each character once for Theta(n) work. A correct calibrated alternative stores segments in a list and linearly scans the growing history for each candidate, taking a genuinely superlinear principal class; it must pass every output and fail only the scaling verdict.
